Maintenance release. The plugin's description in `manifest.json` no longer contains the word "Obsidian" — the community directory's automated review flags it as redundant, and 0.2.0 was removed from the listing over that single line. No code changes since 0.2.0.

Install by hand: put `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css` into `<vault>/.obsidian/plugins/beresta/` and enable the plugin in settings.

Without the Beresta app there is nothing to show: the snapshot it reads is written by the app into your vault.
